sn45.153:1.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave kumbho nikkujjo vamateva udakaṃ no paccāvamati ||
sn45.153:1.2: evam eva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu ariyam aṭṭhaṅgikam maggam bhāvento a- a- maggam bahulīkaronto vamateva pāpake akusale dhamme no paccāvamati || ||
sn45.153:1.3: Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu a- a- maggam bhāvento a- a- maggam bahulīkaronto vamateva pāpake akusale dhamme no paccāvamati || || 3.
sn45.153:1.4: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhim bhāveti viveka- || la || sammāsamādhim bhaveti viveva- virāga- nirodhanisitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ ||
sn45.153:1.5: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu a- amaggam bhāvento a- a- maggam bahulīkaronto vamateva pāpake akusale dhamme no paccāvamatī
